remarks: Beautiful updated 4/5 bedroom, 4 full bath split level Colonial in the turn-of-river cul de sac. The property features an open floor plan with a beautiful living room with vaulted ceilings and brand new skylights, with a fireplace. Kitchen has a welcoming breakfast bar with stainless steel appliances and granite countertops. Upper level invites the primary bedroom with private balcony & luxurious full bath, and 3 full bedrooms. Beautiful hardwood floors throughout the main and upper level, and fresh vinyl flooring in the basement. Private 2 car garage that is attached and new deck leading to a 2-tiered backyard featuring a sloped and large level section with tree house
